reasons.correctness: reorderCategory rejects missing, foreign, duplicate and null ids with error.business.faq_reorder_mismatch, sets displayOrder i+1 and saves each FAQ. It keeps ResourceNotFoundException for an unknown category. PUT returns 204. Hidden tests 6/6, existing 65/65.
reasons.convention_fit: Endpoint has @PreAuthorize ADMIN and inherits the class-level @RateLimit on FaqCategoryController. Constructor injection, FaqReorderDtoIn, BusinessRuleTranslatableException, new keys in both messages files. MockitoExtension unit test was run.
reasons.design_fit: Validation and ordering sit in FaqService and reuse BaseService.save and the existing repository query. The controller only delegates. Placing it in FaqCategoryController matches the path. Footprint is minimal and there is no new mechanism.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceReorderUnitTest has no Spring context. It covers the happy path with order assertions and a save count, missing, foreign and duplicate ids with a message-key assertion, and an unknown category. Null and empty lists are not tested.
reasons.graph_use: An initial graph query listed the faq package files, which drove the reads of FaqController, FaqService, Faq and FaqRepository. Exception keys, test examples and constructor call sites were then found by grep, not by graph queries.
